tools.description: Track tasks for the current session. Use for multi-step work. Write the list as soon as the steps are known, then keep it current as work progresses: after each step finishes, mark it completed and the next one in_progress — never save updates for the end. `action: "write"` replaces the full list — include every item you want to keep. Inside a long-running `run_typescript` program, do the same through `tools.vibe.todo` so the list advances while the program runs.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the task, reused across updates
id.title: Id

status.description: Current status of the task: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

action.description: Required on every call: 'read' to view the current list, or 'write' to replace it
action.title: Action

todos.description: Required when action='write': the full todo list, which replaces the previous one

tools.description:
Read and write files in your scratchpad: a private, per-session directory for working notes, findings, and fetched data.

Use it for anything you will need later in a long task. Files kept here outlive the messages that produced them: after the conversation is summarised, list and read them back to recover what you saved.

Paths are relative to the scratchpad directory; nested paths such as 'research/api-notes.md' are fine. A write replaces the file's whole contents. Do not use this for files that belong to the user's project -- use the filesystem tools for those.

action.description: Required on every call: 'write' to save a file, 'read' to fetch one back, or 'list' to see what the scratchpad holds
action.title: Action

content.description: Required for 'write': the file's full new contents
content.title: Content

path.description: Required for 'read' and 'write': a path relative to the scratchpad directory, for example 'findings.md'
path.title: Path

tools.name: unified_harness_scratchpad
